processes:task-fa-build-record-8xhsv3.business_purpose: It exists so the talks behind every facility can be evidenced whenever its terms are questioned.
processes:task-fa-build-record-8xhsv3.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the negotiation trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a facility review would consult.

processes:task-fa-build-confirm-qa8s28.plain_language_description: When the talks stand settled, the confirmation custodian reconciles the negotiated lines against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The papering work that follows learns what was agreed and can formalize it.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-qa8s28.business_purpose: It exists so facilities are papered only over lines confirmed as negotiated.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-qa8s28.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the negotiated lines await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the settled lines against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the papering work needs.

processes:task-fa-build-intake-5rk9hx.plain_language_name: Receive the Funding Structure Design for the Talks
processes:task-fa-build-intake-5rk9hx.plain_language_description: Negotiation opens when the funding structure design is handed over as the frame the talks must land inside. The intake custodian accepts it, registers it with audit identifiers, and starts the negotiation from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-5rk9hx.business_purpose: It exists so lines are negotiated within a registered structure rather than to whatever a lender offers.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-5rk9hx.practical_context: It opens when the structure design is presented for the talks, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the finance function registers the funding structure design as the negotiation baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-fa-build-transform-x46qzg.plain_language_name: Talk the Lenders to Committed Lines
processes:task-fa-build-transform-x46qzg.plain_language_description: With the design verified, the processing custodian does the negotiation itself: the talks are carried to committed lines that sit inside the structure's frame, and the negotiated funding lines are set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-x46qzg.business_purpose: It exists because a funding need on paper funds nothing - the negotiation is where the need becomes committed money.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-x46qzg.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified design is ready to be negotiated within, and it ends with the negotiated lines produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the finance function carries the talks to lines that sit inside the structure's frame, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-build-verify-xxb9wr.plain_language_name: Check the Design Before Opening the Talks
processes:task-fa-build-verify-xxb9wr.plain_language_description: Before anything is negotiated, the verification custodian checks the structure design against what negotiation requires - that the funding need is quantified and the structure's boundaries are stated. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the talks open.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-xxb9wr.business_purpose: It exists so the talks never open without a frame to keep them honest.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-xxb9wr.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the design can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the funding need unquantified and logs the defect before the talks open.

processes:task-fa-build-record-b2fbmq.plain_language_name: File the Function Stand-Up Audit Record
processes:task-fa-build-record-b2fbmq.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the stand-up trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. How the function was assembled, and against which model, stays readable whenever its conduct is examined.
processes:task-fa-build-record-b2fbmq.business_purpose: It exists so the assembly of the function can be evidenced whenever its conduct is questioned.
processes:task-fa-build-record-b2fbmq.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the stand-up trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles an operating review would consult.

processes:task-fa-build-confirm-6tbz5j.plain_language_description: When the function stands assembled, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The secured facilities learn they have operators and the build closes.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-6tbz5j.business_purpose: It exists so facilities are treated as secured only once their operators are confirmed in place.
processes:task-fa-build-confirm-6tbz5j.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the stood-up function awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the assembled function against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation that closes the build.

processes:task-fa-build-intake-be5y6s.plain_language_name: Receive the Operating Model and Plan Structure
processes:task-fa-build-intake-be5y6s.plain_language_description: Stand-up opens when the treasury operating model and the plan structure are handed over together as the frame the function will be assembled to. The intake custodian accepts both, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the stand-up from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-be5y6s.business_purpose: It exists so the function is assembled to a registered model rather than to whoever is available.
processes:task-fa-build-intake-be5y6s.practical_context: It opens when the model and structure are presented for the stand-up, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the finance function registers the operating model and plan structure as the stand-up baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-fa-build-transform-whn4sg.plain_language_name: Assemble the Team That Will Run the Money
processes:task-fa-build-transform-whn4sg.plain_language_description: With the frame verified, the processing custodian does the stand-up itself: the roles, mandates, and tooling are assembled into a working function able to operate the secured facilities and systems, set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-whn4sg.business_purpose: It exists because facilities and systems without operators are just paper and software - the stand-up is what gives the money its hands.
processes:task-fa-build-transform-whn4sg.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified frame is ready to be assembled from, and it ends with the stood-up function produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the finance function assembles the roles and mandates that will run the money, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-build-verify-uhgx6t.plain_language_name: Check the Model Before Assembling the Team
processes:task-fa-build-verify-uhgx6t.plain_language_description: Before anything is assembled, the verification custodian checks the operating model against what stand-up requires - that every role the facilities demand is stated in the model. Gaps are logged for rejection or repair before the assembly begins.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-uhgx6t.business_purpose: It exists so no facility stands secured with nobody designed to operate it.
processes:task-fa-build-verify-uhgx6t.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the model can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its gaps logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a facility with no operating role behind it and logs the gap before the assembly begins.

processes:task-fa-conceive-record-amzehj.plain_language_name: File the Strategy Context Audit Record
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-amzehj.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the assessment trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What the assessment concluded about the need, and from which signals, stays readable whenever the strategy's premise is examined.
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-amzehj.business_purpose: It exists so the premise behind the strategy can be evidenced against the signals it was read from.
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-amzehj.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the assessment trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a strategy review would consult.

processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-zse2f.plain_language_description: When the context stands assessed, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The funding framing that follows learns the context is settled and the approach can be framed within it.
processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-zse2f.business_purpose: It exists so the approach is framed only within a context confirmed as assessed.
processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-zse2f.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the assessed context awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the assessed context against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the funding framing needs.

processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-wk3nyn.plain_language_name: Receive the Enterprise State and Outside Signals
processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-wk3nyn.plain_language_description: Assessment opens when the enterprise state and the regulatory and market signals are handed over together as the material the context will be read from. The intake custodian accepts both, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the assessment from a recorded base.
processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-wk3nyn.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy answers a registered reading of why it is needed, not a hunch.
processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-wk3nyn.practical_context: It opens when the state and signals are presented for the assessment, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function registers the enterprise state and outside signals as the assessment baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-h2m.plain_language_name: Read Why the Money Model Must Move
processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-h2m.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian makes the assessment itself: whether the need is a new model, a reframe, or an answer to outside pressure is read out of the state and signals, and the assessed context is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-h2m.business_purpose: It exists because a money strategy that never asks why it exists solves the wrong problem confidently.
processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-h2m.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be read from, and it ends with the assessed strategy context produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function reads whether the need is a new model, a reframe, or an outside answer, and records the context.

processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-devvev.plain_language_name: Check the Signals Before Reading the Context
processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-devvev.plain_language_description: Before the context is read, the verification custodian checks the state and signals against what assessment requires - that the signals are current and the state reading is complete. Defects are flagged for rejection or repair before the assessment is made.
processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-devvev.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy is never framed from stale signals about a moving enterprise.
processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-devvev.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a market signal already superseded and flags the defect before the context is read.

processes:task-fa-conceive-record-vw9yr8.plain_language_name: File the Finance Strategy Audit Record
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-vw9yr8.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the commitment trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What the committed strategy contains, and from which framings it was consolidated, stays on file for the life of the strategy.
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-vw9yr8.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy's standing as committed direction can be evidenced whenever build and operation lean on it.
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-vw9yr8.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the commitment trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a build review would draw on.

processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-vsy3d.plain_language_description: When the strategy stands committed, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The build work downstream learns the committed finance direction is ready to be received.
processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-vsy3d.business_purpose: It exists so build starts only from a strategy confirmed as committed.
processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-vsy3d.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the committed strategy awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-yjqqx8.plain_language_name: Receive the Monetary Model and the Funding Approach
processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-yjqqx8.plain_language_description: The commit opens when the framed monetary model and the funding approach are handed over together as the pieces the strategy must be consolidated from. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the commitment from a recorded base.
processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-yjqqx8.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy is committed from registered pieces rather than from a loose sheaf of framings.
processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-yjqqx8.practical_context: It opens when the framed pieces are presented for the commitment, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the framed model and approach as the commitment baseline, with audit references, and opens the consolidation.

processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-8ff.plain_language_name: Consolidate the Framings into the Committed Strategy
processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-8ff.plain_language_description: With the pieces verified, the processing custodian does the consolidation itself: the monetary model and the funding approach are brought together into the committed strategy, set down in the form the activity defines and ready for build. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-8ff.business_purpose: It exists because framings scattered across documents direct nobody - the commit is where the strategy becomes one authority ready for build.
processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-8ff.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified pieces are ready to be consolidated, and it ends with the committed strategy produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function consolidates the framings into the committed money strategy, ready for build, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-gnukmy.plain_language_name: Check the Framings Before They Are Committed
processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-gnukmy.plain_language_description: Before the strategy is committed, the verification custodian checks the framed pieces against what commitment requires - that the monetary model and funding approach are both settled and neither arrived half-framed. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the commitment is made.
processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-gnukmy.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy is never committed from pieces that were only partly framed.
processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-gnukmy.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the pieces can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or repair.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the funding approach still carrying open questions and logs the defect before the strategy is committed.

processes:task-fa-conceive-record-b8wpp7.business_purpose: It exists so the capital choices behind the strategy can be evidenced whenever they are questioned.
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-b8wpp7.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the framing trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a strategy review would consult.

processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-wcbap.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy is committed only over an approach confirmed as framed.
processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-wcbap.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the framed approach awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-4kx4pq.business_purpose: It exists so the capital posture is framed within a registered model rather than against appetite.
processes:task-fa-conceive-intake-4kx4pq.practical_context: It opens when the bounded model is presented for the framing, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.
